entity.name: Island Wing Company
entity.description: It's always a fun time on the Island. If you're looking for good food, delicious drinks, and a lively atmosphere to enjoy with friends and family – look no further. You don't need a passport to savor some of the best eats and drinks around. We've perfected baking, steaming, and grilling so you can find your favorite from our extensive menu including crispy chicken wings, juicy burgers and more. Choose the perfect drink from our large draft beer list, frozen drinks, and cocktails. Sit back and enjoy Island Time with us when you stop by to watch the latest game, enjoy live music, or catch up with loved ones. Come find out why it's always a little better on the Island.
entity.cuisine_type: American Casual Dining - Chicken Wings, Burgers, Tacos, Mac and Cheese
entity.atmosphere: Casual dining environment with Island Fun theme, lively atmosphere for watching games and live music
